description: This source file manages the logic for a theory exam page in an online examination system. It handles loading questions from a database, displaying them, tracking exam timer, and submitting answers to the database, including updating relevant queues and status tables.

classes.name: TheoryExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the TheoryExam.aspx page, handling exam question display, timer, submit, and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Initializes the exam page by fetching questions based on session info, setting up timer, and verifying user login.

methods.name: getCourseName
methods.description: Returns the full course name corresponding to a course ID.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the user profile page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Stores the user's answers in the database, updates course queues, and records the exam as taken.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates the countdown timer display, and indicates time-out when the timer ends.
